Name: Dice Floors
Author: shalassa
Description:
This adds all six faces (and a clean zero) of a die as flooring. As simple as that. Roll that d6 to your heart's content!





[b][u]Requirements

[/u][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ (not strictly necessary but highly recommended if you like decorating and have additional furniture, wallpaper, or flooring)


[b][u]Installation[/u][/b]

Just copy the unzipped (!) folder into your Mods folder, or let your favourite mod manager do the work for you.



[b][u]Uninstallation[/u][/b]

Just remove the folder from your Mods folder, or just delete it with your favourite mod manager.



[b][u]Compatability[/u][/b]

Should be compatible with everything.
